unsuccessfulInquiries.exceptions: Converted clients follow a separately reviewed contract/accounting schedule. Suspend deletion for a documented dispute or legal preservation need, with a reason and review date. These exceptions do not authorize indefinite storage of all leads.
procedure: Identify the exact inquiry reference and last substantive contact before deletion; the database creation timestamp alone cannot establish subsequent email contact.
Check whether the inquiry converted to a client or has a documented preservation exception.
Delete the exact eligible D1 record through the authenticated operator and verify absence.
Remove matching owner-controlled email and export copies through their normal controls. Record only a minimal deletion result without retaining the original inquiry body.
Verify provider backup/recovery retention before publishing a universal deletion promise. Do not claim provider-held backup copies disappear immediately.
unsuccessfulInquiries.executionStatus: Authenticated retention preview and explicit contact/client/hold tracking implemented. Weekly owner review and specific record confirmation remain required; no automatic inquiry deletion.

rationale: 90 days leaves a practical window to reopen a short project discussion while limiting storage of unsuccessful leads. This is a chosen operating default, not a proven most-common period.

guidance.supports: Keep information only as long as needed; document retention and secure disposal. Does not prescribe 90 days.
